evaluation.summary: The platform learning section is integrated with Products and Benchmarks. Navigation, OEM switching, model details, comparisons, saved links and responsive layouts passed the current browser review. The package rebuilds from retained ChipIndex sources and preserves all 102 reviewed records and illustrations.
strengths: Products, Benchmarks and Platforms provide reciprocal navigation under a project deployment path.
The existing exact-CPU compatibility dialog remains distinct and links to the broader family guide.
The integrated package preserves the reviewed catalog and art exactly, with automatic checks for unexpected changes.
All five OEM learning guides and supporting evidence remain available locally.
limitations: Coverage is curated and partial; a missing profile does not establish incompatibility.
System configuration and orderability still require OEM confirmation. HPE QuickSpecs remain the primary HPE configuration source.
This review validates integration and sampled workflows, not a fresh review of every hardware specification or every possible configuration.
Publishing to the public ChipIndex site remains a separate owner action.
